styles.name: ink and mustard
styles.why: An ink hero, serif headlines and a mono for data bits over a precise sans; suits analytical and professional courses.

styles.name: dark bootcamp
styles.why: Energetic dark look for tech bootcamps and creator courses.

pitfalls: Outcome or salary claims without evidence.
Live session times without a time zone.
Refund, cancellation and withdrawal rights missing near the price.
A curriculum map that only works by dragging; keep the module list as text.
Student projects or quotes published without consent.
'Certificate' implied to be accredited when it is not.
